global_changes.note: Hero ranks now grant bonuses
Platinum: reduces all incoming damage in Arena mode by 10%
Master: increases all outgoing damage in Arena mode by 10%
Grandmaster: grants 1 extra coin per game played with this hero
Arenas 1, 2, 4 and 6 have been changed
Added a new hero selection interface
Hero rank bonuses are back in the game
The cost of voting for a new hero decreased from 500,000 to 450,000 coins
Health Regeneration changed from 3/6/9 to 5/10
Health Regeneration (0.25%/0.5%/0.75%) moved from «Talent 5» to «Talent 6» and no longer requires upgrading other talents
«Health Regen Amplification: 7%/14%» replaced with «Damage Reduction from Attacks: 4%/8%/12%», and the talent no longer requires upgrading other talents
«Status Resistance: 7%/14%/21%» replaced with «Additional Cast Range: 100/200»
«Additional Cast Range: 150/300» replaced with «Status Resistance: 10%/20%»
Attack Speed (5%/10%/15%) moved from «Talent 5» to «Talent 6» and no longer requires upgrading other talents
Chance to avoid any damage changed from 4%/8%/12% to 4%/8%
Mana Regeneration changed from 3/6/9 to 5/10
Mana Regeneration (0.5%/1%/1.5%) moved from «Talent 5» to «Talent 6» and no longer requires upgrading other talents
Spell Lifesteal increased from 7%/14% to 7%/14%/21%
«Spell Lifesteal Amplification: 7%/14%/21%» replaced with «Permanently grants a barrier that absorbs any damage: 150/300. Cooldown: 15s», and the talent no longer requires upgrading other talents
Added the Axe set

item_notes.note: Phantom Province: spell damage no longer amplifies attacks
Phantom Province: mana cost per attack decreased from 150 to 120

abilities.name: Berserker's Call
description: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration. Radius: 315. Bonus armor: 12 / 13 / 14 / 15. Duration: 1.8 / 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.7. Cooldown: 17 / 15 / 13 / 11. Mana cost: 80 / 90 / 100 / 110.

abilities.name: Battle Hunger
description: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The damage is increased by a factor of Axe's armor. The enemy is also slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe. Duration: 12. Movement slow: -15% / -20% / -25% / -30%. Damage per second: 12 / 18 / 24 / 30. Armor multiplier: 1. Cooldown: 20 / 15 / 10 / 5. Cast range: 700 / 775 / 850 / 925. Mana cost: 50 / 60 / 70 / 80.

abilities.name: Counter Helix
description: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies. Damage: 100 / 120 / 140 / 160. Attacks to helix: 7 / 6 / 5 / 4. Radius: 275. Cooldown: 0.3.

abilities.name: Culling Blade
description: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor. Damage: 275 / 375 / 475. Kill move speed bonus: 20% / 25% / 30%. Kill armor bonus: 20 / 25 / 30. Kill buff duration: 6. Kill buff radius: 900. Cooldown: 80 / 75 / 70. Cast range: 175. Mana cost: 100 / 125 / 150.
